title: 永夜行囊｜美術探索 Round 01
purpose: 10 款完整遊戲概念畫面；供美術方向選擇，非可執行遊戲

styles.name: 精緻像素冒險
styles.tag: 像素 · 寶石色 · 懷舊
styles.description: 細膩像素、青綠森林與琥珀色光點，裝備像值得收藏的小寶物。
styles.tradeoff: 後續需人工校正像素網格，動畫必須維持一致的像素尺寸。
styles.art: True exquisite 16-bit pixel art. Visible deliberate square pixels, no smooth illustration outlines, no painterly smears. Jewel-toned teal foliage, amber sunlight, violet shadows. Compact 3-head-tall pixel adventurer; detailed readable pixel icons. Ornate but restrained pixel UI borders. All parts, including environment and interface, share coherent pixel craft.
styles.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished original mobile fantasy backpack auto-battler GAME SCREEN concept, portrait 9:16, preferably 1152 x 2048. This is a usable-looking game screenshot, NOT a poster, cover, phone photographed on a table, multi-panel sheet or character close-up. Full bleed canvas, no phone frame, no watermarks, no outside captions.
Game: Evernight: Packbound, but DO NOT print a game title or style label in the image.

Top 8%: a restrained status HUD displaying exactly "LV 5", "1-3", and a clearly visible red HP bar with "84/100".
Next 34%: a SIDE-VIEW forest-ruin battle lane. Full-body human adventurer on LEFT facing RIGHT, wearing a hooded travel cloak, a visible backpack, holding a short sword; exactly ONE wolf companion beside them; exactly ONE skeleton enemy on RIGHT with a rusty sword. A moss-covered broken stone arch and two forest trees in background. Both sides grounded on the same clearly visible horizontal path, character height about half the battle panel height. Scene looks playable, not a landscape illustration with tiny characters. Keep silhouettes separated from background.

Large centered inventory, no extra grid rows or columns. Six clearly recognizable items, one of each, positioned exactly as follows:
- a vertical short sword in column 1 spanning rows 1-2;
- a vertical curved bow in column 2 spanning rows 1-3;
- a vertical crystal-tipped magic staff in column 3 spanning rows 1-3;
- a leather chest armor occupying rows 1-2, columns 4-5;
- a round shield occupying rows 3-4, columns 4-5;
- one gold ring in row 4, column 1.
Cells row3/col1, row4/col2, row4/col3 are empty and visible. These are SIX large multi-cell collectible illustrations, not repeated icons per cell.
